profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer | 8+ yrs React · TypeScript · AWS | K-12 EdTech & AI-powered assessment (QTI, OpenAI) | Redux, Node, DynamoDB
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years building customer-facing K-12 EdTech that serves over a million users at 99%+ uptime. I started at PowerSchool in 2018 fixing bugs and grew into leading product-agnostic micro front-end architecture, AI-powered assessment tooling, and QTI-based test and rubric platforms.
Recent work I'm proud of:
- Built an AI item-generator that turns a teacher's prompt into properly formatted QTI questions via the OpenAI API.
- Designed an AI credit system that meters usage across the platform so AI features can be billed accurately and never run away on cost.
- Replaced a legacy jQuery question-creation page with a full React SPA (Redux Toolkit, Lambda, DynamoDB, CKEditor 5) supporting 15 question interaction types.
- Delivered a QTI Test Creator with automatic scoring and gradebook posting, plus a suite of rubric apps (creator, viewer, catalog) on React, DynamoDB, Lambda, and AWS OpenSearch.
I lead scrum teams, own epics from tech design through GA, and mentor newer developers. I care about accessibility, maintainability, and clean architecture.
When I'm not writing code, you can find me walking my dog, catching a Broadway show with my wife, or teaching myself Godot game development.
Open to connecting — reach me at the.aaron.lee.brooks@gmail.com.
Tech: React, Redux Toolkit, TypeScript, SASS, Node, Java, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, OpenSearch), MySQL, QTI, OpenAI API.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I | React, TypeScript, Java, MySQL, AWS
positions.description:
- Overhauled the student test-taking application, migrating from bespoke CSS to the company's shared styling library and React component system for a consistent, maintainable UI.
- Replaced a legacy HTML/CSS/jQuery question-creation page with a full React SPA (Redux Toolkit, Lambda, DynamoDB, SASS, CKEditor 5), converting 15 distinct question interaction types into a unified editor with QTI standardization and XML↔JSON transformation.
- Built an AI item-generator that turns a user prompt into properly formatted QTI questions via the OpenAI API, feeding directly into the question editor.
- Transitioned from the focused Student Applications team to the broader New Solutions team, building product-agnostic micro front-ends that slot into multiple company applications instead of a single app.
- Designed an AI credit entitlement system that checks org balances before AI actions run across a platform serving 1M+ users — enabling accurate customer billing and protecting the business from uncapped, customer-driven AI spend.
- Built a React SPA companion to a new AI chatbot, letting students select and save interests and learning styles to drive personalized chatbot responses.
- Delivered a QTI-based Test Creator that assembles new and existing questions into assessments, with automatic scoring and gradebook posting.
- Built a suite of rubric applications (creator, viewer, and access-aware catalog) using React, Redux Toolkit, DynamoDB, Lambda, and AWS OpenSearch.
- Contributed to a scrum team (stand-ups, retros, planning), owned epics from tech design through GA release, reviewed code for standards, and mentored newer developers on troubleshooting, standards, and career growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer I/II/III
positions.description:
- Promoted twice (I → II → III) while progressing from maintenance work to owning full-stack features and platform-level projects.
- Started with front-end and build fixes across jQuery, CSS, and Maven, stabilizing existing customer-facing applications.
- Delivered a full-stack FTP log viewer application, building the REST APIs and DataTables-driven UI end to end.
- Led a static file delivery overhaul, moving distribution from a local server warehouse to versioned S3 buckets served through CloudFront.
- Built a series of accessibility and geometry test-taking tools for students, including a focus reader (single-line view), on-screen ruler, protractor, and compass.

positions.title: Software Developer | React Native & AWS Firebase
positions.description:
Built out mobile applications for clients leveraging React Native and Firebase

Produced high quality software using Test Driven Development

Delivered MVPs based on designer mockups on tight timelines

positions.title: Full Stack Development | React, Node, Express, MongoDB
positions.description:
- Howdy Neighbor: "Howdy Neighbor connects DIY-ers with career professionals"

MERN Stack (Mongo, Express, React, Node) · Ask your difficult, confusing, or just downright stupid questions and have them answered by the people who do these tasks for a living. In addition to getting answers to your questions, you can find previous questions that deal with your current problem. Think Stack Overflow, but for your toilet being clogged!

- MyWallet: "MyWallet provides a solution to keep track of your wallet."

JavaScript, NodeJS, Express, HTML5, CSS3, MongoDB, jQuery · If you're like me, MyWallet is your saving grace. MyWallet provides an easy solution to keep track of the items that you have in your wallet for the day when you inevitably lose your Wallet. Just sign into your wallet, log all the items currently in your wallet, and know that it will always be there for safe keeping. Change what's in your wallet? MyWallet allows users the ability to change and delete the items in their wallet in order to keep things current.

- Bring a Dish: "Bring A Dish helps determine what to make for dinner"

jQuery/AJAX/HTML5/CSS3 · Bring A Dish takes the guesswork out of what to make for dinner! Users search what ingredients they currently have in their kitchen, and Bring-A-Dish does the rest. Users will find plenty of recipes that use many of the ingredients they currently have, saving money and time in the grocery store.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Management, Marketing, and Related Support Services
